title: Per-repository integration contract
description: One Stack leaf's drive contract as data. The integration name is the closed roster's; the repository is the checkout directory name under its kit; entry points are repository-owned, documented commands — argv executed with the checkout as working directory, no shell. A missing entry point is a recorded absence, never a license for the Assembler to improvise one.

repository.description: The checkout directory name under the kit; preflight cross-checks it against the environment mapping's declared path.

origin.description: The canonical clone source. bootstrap clones a missing checkout from it; an integration without one cannot be materialized, only reported.
